resolution.note: PLAN.md and preflight removed, ADR 0014 marks stale rows and records D34-D37, instruction-reference rule covers CLAUDE.md and all skills

title: Retired plan text and the preflight script stop misleading agents
body:
Why: #610 left residue: docs/program/PLAN.md is a dead plan still linked from README and CONTEXT, package.json keeps a preflight script beside npm run fast, and ADR 0014 D11/D21/D22/D30 mention gate:local and krn ship without a superseded note.
Outcome: PLAN.md is deleted or reduced to a pointer to roadmap.md, links follow it, preflight is removed or documented as the full local run, and the ADR 0014 entries carry superseded notes.
Proof: grep for PLAN.md, gate:local and 'krn ship' outside docs/adr history prints nothing; npm run fast passes.
Amendment A6 (fable-plan 2.3, AR:241-243): Outcome also removes roadmap row R28 residue, closes P-052, deletes .krn/PLANS.md.

Merged in (Fable plan 1114c): t-a5mv4rz (ADR 0014 records the any-repository and correctness-first decisions and marks stale rows) and t-6vkmy4w (a rule test fails on a path or command named in instruction files that does not exist).
